attempts.note: Meta publishes no OpenAPI document for the WhatsApp Business Platform. Tried /openapi.json, /openapi.yaml, /swagger.json and /.well-known/openapi.json on both graph.facebook.com and developers.facebook.com, and the reference pages' own .json/.md variants; only the markdown rendering exists. (Superseded: Meta does publish one, in the facebook/openapi GitHub repo, not on the docs host; see the last attempt.)

Meta's own machine-readable index of every endpoint reference page, plus the matching .md rendering of each page. The pages are generated from Meta's internal spec and carry base URL, method, path, parameter tables, request/response content types and component schemas, so the whole documented surface is enumerable rather than guessed.

The three Flows reference pages Meta's index links (flows/reference/api-for-whatsapp-flows, whatsapp-extension-preview-api, whatsapp-flow-metric-data-point-api) do not resolve — they return the 'Page Not Found' shell. The Flows and Metrics guides document the same endpoints in full, so the Flows paths were authored from those.

Meta's own Business SDK codegen specs are a proprietary node/edge format, and only a few WhatsApp nodes are published (WhatsAppBusinessAccount, WhatsAppBusinessProfile). No phone-number node and none of the Cloud API messaging or media endpoints. Used only to cross-check the WABA edge list.
Third-party (unblu) spec of the retired WhatsApp Business on-premises API v1.0, not the Cloud API this adaptor calls.
Meta's public workspace renders client-side; the collection JSON is not reachable without a Postman API key.

Meta's own OpenAPI 3.1 for the WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API, Business Management, Flows, Calling, Groups, partner onboarding), MIT licensed, published in the facebook/openapi repo. 113 operations over 78 paths. Earlier runs missed it: the docs pages do not link it.

notes: The WhatsApp Business Platform, served over the Meta Graph API at graph.facebook.com. Meta publishes its own OpenAPI 3.1 document for it (facebook/openapi, business-messaging-api_v23.0.yaml), committed verbatim as upstream.yaml: 113 operations over 78 paths covering the Cloud API (messages, encrypted messages, media, registration and verification, business profile, blocking, calling, groups, QR codes, message history), the Business Management API (WABAs, phone numbers, templates, subscribed apps, analytics, Flows) and partner/solution onboarding. It replaces the docs-authored spec of 2026-09-13 (106 operations). Diffed against that spec: the vendor document adds 8 operations the docs pages did not surface (messages_encrypted, message_history, migrate_flows, the three OBO/solution migration intents, in_progress_onbehalf_request, and the webhook receiver /whatsapp/webhooks), and lacks only GET/POST /{Business-ID}/whatsapp_business_accounts, which the docs described but Meta's spec covers through owned_whatsapp_business_accounts and client_whatsapp_business_accounts. Paths carry the Graph API version as a /{Version} path parameter on server https://graph.facebook.com, as Meta writes them. The adaptor exposes a single generic request(method, path, body, options) that joins the configured apiVersion (and phoneNumberId) onto the path, so it reaches every operation here; verified against ast.json and the adaptor source. Matching caveat: as in the Graph API itself, 15 node paths share one URL shape (/{Version}/{Business-ID}, /{Version}/{Phone-Number-ID}, /{Version}/{Media-ID}, /{Version}/{WABA-ID}, ...), and request_code/verify_code exist under both Phone-Number-ID and Pre-Verified-Phone-Number-ID. Only the kind of ID tells them apart, so a path-only matcher (the conformer, the storybook's resource attribution) picks the first declared template: GET /v22.0/<phone-number-id> is attributed to getBusinessPortfolioSpecificFields. Downstream coverage for those node-level operations should be read with that in mind.
